text: Re-running the command reported that the `yolo-twice` marketplace was already declared in user settings, so nothing changed. The folder-source marketplace serves plugin `yolo-twice@yolo-twice` v0.1.2 (enabled, user scope), read live from `code/plugin` in the checkout, so edits there reach new Claude Code sessions without reinstalling. The plugin's command is `/yolo-twice:yolo-twice`.
